messages.subject: "derived" should now be "transformed" in models
parts:
I changed the keyword "derived" to "transformed"
in the models. I replaced in all the models after
a fairly cursory check that it wouldn't cause
damage, but there may be some cleaning up to do in
some of the models. I also re-organized the
non-BUGS models a bit.

So now a Stan program looks like:

data { ... }
transformed data { ... }
parameters { ... }
transformed parameters { ... }
model { ... }
generated quantities { ... }

with everything but the model block optional.

Every variable other than a local variable can have
constraints, and the constraints are tested:

data, transformed data: data read time, before sampling

parameters: test on inits if inits provided

transformed parameters: test on write (NOT every leapfrog step)

generated quantities: test on write (only generated as sample is written)

- Bob
